title: Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) Shares Sold by First Financial Corp IN
text:
Posted by Sebastian Weber on Apr 23rd, 2018 // No Comments 
First Financial Corp IN decreased its holdings in shares of Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 6.0% during the fourth quarter, according to its most recent Form 13F filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission. The institutional investor owned 13,004 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 832 shares during the quarter. Apple accounts for approximately 1.4% of First Financial Corp IN’s holdings, making the stock its 10th biggest position. First Financial Corp IN’s holdings in Apple were worth $2,201,000 at the end of the most recent quarter. 
Several other hedge funds have also modified their holdings of AAPL. Beach Investment Management LLC. lifted its position in shares of Apple by 1,517.7% in the second quarter. Beach Investment Management LLC. now owns 178,109 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $25,651,000 after buying an additional 167,099 shares during the last quarter. Catalyst Capital Advisors LLC lifted its position in shares of Apple by 39.8% in the second quarter. Catalyst Capital Advisors LLC now owns 69,900 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $10,067,000 after buying an additional 19,900 shares during the last quarter. IFC Holdings Incorporated FL lifted its position in shares of Apple by 1.1% in the second quarter. IFC Holdings Incorporated FL now owns 85,072 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $12,224,000 after buying an additional 885 shares during the last quarter. Wedbush Securities Inc. lifted its position in shares of Apple by 3.6% in the second quarter. Wedbush Securities Inc. now owns 156,649 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $22,561,000 after buying an additional 5,435 shares during the last quarter. Finally, Berkeley Capital Partners LLC lifted its position in shares of Apple by 0.6% in the second quarter. Berkeley Capital Partners LLC now owns 4,369 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $629,000 after buying an additional 26 shares during the last quarter. Institutional investors and hedge funds own 61.35% of the company’s stock. 
Shares of AAPL stock traded down $7.08 during trading hours on Friday, reaching $165.72. The company had a trading volume of 65,491,140 shares, compared to its average volume of 29,789,462. The company has a quick ratio of 1.20, a current ratio of 1.24 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74. The company has a market cap of $840,865.50, a P/E ratio of 17.99, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.26 and a beta of 1.25. Apple has a 1-year low of $141.85 and a 1-year high of $183.50. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share for the quarter, beating the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $3.82 by $0.07. The company had revenue of $88.29 billion for the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $87.62 billion. Apple had a return on equity of 37.37% and a net margin of 21.13%. The firm’s quarterly revenue was up 12.7% on a year-over-year basis. During the same quarter in the prior year, the business posted $3.36 EPS. research analysts anticipate that Apple will post 11.3 earnings per share for the current fiscal year. 
In related news, insider Philip W. Schiller sold 69,491 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction on Tuesday, April 3rd. The shares were sold at an average price of $166.42, for a total value of $11,564,692.22. The transaction was disclosed in a legal filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is available at this link . Also, insider Luca Maestri sold 39,122 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction on Friday, April 13th. The shares were sold at an average price of $174.66, for a total transaction of $6,833,048.52. Following the completion of the sale, the insider now owns 64,475 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $11,261,203.50. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . In the last three months, insiders sold 125,988 shares of company stock worth $21,336,201. 0.08% of the stock is currently owned by company insiders. 
A number of analysts have weighed in on AAPL shares. Rosenblatt Securities set a $180.00 price target on Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research report on Tuesday, December 26th. Wells Fargo reaffirmed a “hold” rating and issued a $195.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research report on Wednesday, December 27th. ValuEngine raised Apple from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating in a research report on Sunday, December 31st. Piper Jaffray reiterated a “buy” rating and issued a $200.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research note on Tuesday, January 2nd. Finally, Zacks Investment Research upgraded Apple from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating and set a $190.00 price objective on the stock in a research note on Wednesday, January 3rd. Two research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have given a hold rating, thirty-two have issued a buy rating and one has issued a strong buy rating to the stock. Apple has a consensus rating of “Buy” and a consensus target price of $203.15. The Company’s products and services include iPhone, iPad, Mac, iPod, Apple TV, a portfolio of consumer and professional software applications, the iOS and OS X operating systems, iCloud, and a variety of accessory, service and support offerings.
